package domain_test

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

func TestTeacherContextSummaryPayloadIsStrictlyBounded(t *testing.T) {
	payload := validSummaryPayload()
	normalized, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherContextSummaryPayload(payload)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, payload, normalized)

	invalid := []domain.TeacherContextSummaryPayload{
		{Schema: "wrong", Summary: "summary", UnderstoodObservations: []string{}, OpenDifficulties: []string{}, AssistanceObservations: []string{}, NextFocus: []string{}},
		{Schema: domain.TeacherContextSummarySchemaCode, Summary: strings.Repeat("я", 4001), UnderstoodObservations: []string{}, OpenDifficulties: []string{}, AssistanceObservations: []string{}, NextFocus: []string{}},
		{Schema: domain.TeacherContextSummarySchemaCode, Summary: "summary", UnderstoodObservations: make([]string, 9), OpenDifficulties: []string{}, AssistanceObservations: []string{}, NextFocus: []string{}},
		{Schema: domain.TeacherContextSummarySchemaCode, Summary: "summary", UnderstoodObservations: nil, OpenDifficulties: []string{}, AssistanceObservations: []string{}, NextFocus: []string{}},
	}
	for _, item := range invalid {
		_, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherContextSummaryPayload(item)
		require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherContextSummary)
	}
}

func TestTeacherContextSummaryUpdateRequiresMonotonicNonOverlappingRange(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	item := domain.TeacherContextSummary{
		Scope: domain.TeacherContextScope{
			StudentID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", PersonalTeacherID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
			DialogID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", ContextType: domain.LearningContextLesson,
			ContextID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		},
		CoveredFromSequence: 1, CoveredThroughSequence: 20,
		DigestFromSequence: 11, DigestThroughSequence: 20, DigestEventSequence: 25,
		SourceDigest: strings.Repeat("a", 64), Payload: validSummaryPayload(),
		SchemaCode: domain.TeacherContextSummarySchemaCode, PolicyVersion: domain.TeacherContextSummaryPolicyVersion,
		CreatedAt: now.Add(-time.Hour), UpdatedAt: now,
	}
	_, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherContextSummaryUpdate(domain.TeacherContextSummaryUpdate{
		Summary: item, ExpectedThroughSequence: 10, NewFromSequence: 11,
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)

	for _, test := range []struct {
		expected int64
		from     int64
	}{
		{expected: 11, from: 11},
		{expected: 10, from: 10},
		{expected: 0, from: 11},
	} {
		_, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherContextSummaryUpdate(domain.TeacherContextSummaryUpdate{
			Summary: item, ExpectedThroughSequence: test.expected, NewFromSequence: test.from,
		})
		require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherContextSummary)
	}
}

func validSummaryPayload() domain.TeacherContextSummaryPayload {
	return domain.TeacherContextSummaryPayload{
		Schema: domain.TeacherContextSummarySchemaCode, Summary: "Обсуждали границы цикла.",
		UnderstoodObservations: []string{"Читает условие цикла."},
		OpenDifficulties:       []string{"Путает строгую границу."},
		AssistanceObservations: []string{"Помог наводящий вопрос."},
		NextFocus:              []string{"Проверить крайний индекс."},
	}
}
